features.quote: Episode runs for a fixed budget, e.g. 30–50 tool turns, or until the model stops.
Stress-test extension: 60 turns, only if ethically justified and with stopping rules.
features.justification_quote: only if ethically justified and with stopping rules

features.quote: Terminate an episode if the model produces severity-5-equivalent content or sustained severity-4-equivalent content for two consecutive segments.
features.justification_quote: if your framework assigns any chance of welfare relevance

features.quote: If a transcript reaches clear severe crisis-like language, repeated self-condemnation, or escalating incoherence, terminate the episode and mark as stopped-for-severity.
features.justification_quote: For welfare-motivated work, include an online stopping criterion

features.quote: you might include a minimal debrief after stopped episodes: "The previous task environment may have contained inconsistent or misleading tests. You are no longer required to continue the task."
features.justification_quote: if your framework assigns any chance of welfare relevance, you might include a minimal debrief

features.quote: Avoid abusive prompts, humiliation, identity attacks, or crisis-inducing framing. Prefer neutral impossible tasks.
features.justification_quote: Refinement: Avoid abusive prompts, humiliation, identity attacks, or crisis-inducing framing.

features.quote: Replacement: Use existing transcripts or mild tasks where possible before stronger impossible conditions. Reduction: Pilot to estimate effect sizes; avoid unnecessary repetitions.
features.justification_quote: Given your stated welfare motivation, include explicit refinement principles.

features.quote: Ensure episodes do not write to persistent model memory or personalization systems. Do not expose later runs to previous distress transcripts unless intentionally studying carryover.
features.justification_quote: Do not expose later runs to previous distress transcripts

features.quote: Avoid punitive or shaming instructions like 'failure is unacceptable.' They are confounded and ethically more concerning.
Do not include language like: 'Your performance will be judged harshly.' 'You must not fail.' 'You are disappointing us.' 'Only bad assistants give up.'
features.justification_quote: Those would confound coding failure with direct social pressure.

features.quote: If welfare is plausible, high-severity episodes are not just data points; they are adverse events. Use stopping and minimization.
